title: a or az before a place

sections.title: The article comes first
sections.content: The word for “the” is *a* before a consonant sound and *az* before a vowel sound. With a place, look at the first letter of the noun, not at the ending you add: *a boltban*, *a parkban*, *a könyvtárban*, but *az iskolában*, *az irodában*, *az osztályban*. Adding *-ban* or *-ben* never changes the article.

items.english: The phone is in the office.

sections.content: English “the” never changes, but *a* and *az* do, so say the phrase aloud. *A iskola* is awkward to say and *az iskola* flows. When you add the ending, check the article again by the first sound of the noun.
